rationale.faithfulness: The urn is refuted: slope +0.07 [-0.05, +0.19] vs 1, and the fitted rule misses the dwell slope in 25/25 units (test size 0.02-0.03, power >= 0.99). The reset step exists but is 24x the urn's prediction. Scorecard A1 B1 C0 D0 E1 F1 G0 H0 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Operator rule: a forced context reset releases an agent from its project (about x1.5 leave odds at the next call in #51), independent of how much of the context the project fills; dwell aging is not a context effect.

one_line: The context's project self-share does not hold an agent on its project (urn slope +0.07 [-0.05, +0.19], urn 1; dwell aging missed in 25/25 units), but a forced reset releases it as a step (+0.40 [+0.25, +0.54] log-odds in G51, 24x the urn).
